subject: POC kickoff: scheduling, owners, and success criteria for Stellarmed
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@stellarmed.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff proposal & owners (draft)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our call, we want to lock in a 90-minute POC kickoff to align scope, owners, and success criteria so engineering and procurement know next steps. Suggested agenda:

- Introductions (5)
- Success criteria & acceptance tests (15)
- Network/security checklist and evidence needs (15)
- Demo of integration points (30)
- Timeline, milestones, and owners (15)
- Q&A / next steps (10)

Proposed windows (PST):
- Wed Sep 23, 10:00–11:30
- Thu Sep 24, 13:00–14:30
- Mon Sep 28, 09:00–10:30

Owners from our side: AE: Ben Carter (me) — overall drive; SE: Dylan Brooks — technical lead and demo; Customer Success: Laura Bennett — onboarding plan; Security liaison: Dev Patel (will join if security discussion needed).

I've attached a draft mutual action plan and a POC runbook that maps tasks to owners. Can you confirm which window works for your engineering and procurement teams, and if security should be looped in at the kickoff or in a separate 30-minute follow-up?

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Stellarmed_mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf, POC-Runbook.md

From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@stellarmed.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@stellarmed.com>, security@stellarmed.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff proposal & owners (draft)

Ben —

Appreciate the clear agenda. Procurement is available the week of Sep 22 except for Sep 24 afternoon; engineering can do Sep 23 in the morning but our security lead (Maya Singh) is only available on Sep 28. A couple of asks:

1) Can we split the kickoff into a 90-minute technical + timeline session with engineering and procurement, and schedule a focused 30-minute security review on Sep 28?
2) We need the SOC 2 evidence request in advance so our security team can pre-screen — can you share the checklist?

If that approach works, propose:
- Primary kickoff: Wed Sep 23, 10:00–11:30 (technical + procurement)
- Security review: Mon Sep 28, 09:30–10:00

I'll have Procurement on the primary kickoff and add Maya to the security review.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Wu | Director of Platform Engineering | Stellarmed
alex.wu@stellarmed.com

Subject: Re: POC kickoff proposal & owners (draft)

Alex —

That split makes sense and aligns with how we typically ensure security doesn’t block the timeline. Confirming the plan:

1) Primary POC kickoff (technical + procurement): Wed Sep 23, 10:00–11:30 PST — owners:
   - Ben Carter (AE) — agenda/contract milestones
   - Dylan Brooks (SE) — technical demo & integration checklist
   - Laura Bennett (CS) — onboarding and success metrics
   - Alex Wu (Stellarmed) — engineering owner
   - Procurement (Stellarmed) — procurement owner
2) Security review (30m): Mon Sep 28, 09:30–10:00 PST — owners:
   - Dev Patel (security liaison from Redwood) — SOC 2 evidence & network items
   - Maya Singh (Stellarmed) — security owner

I've attached the SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx for Maya to pre-screen. Dylan, if you can prepare a 10m deep-dive on model input/output schemas and a short note on expected inference latency at 1k tokens/sec per second, that would be ideal.

Alex, I'll send calendar invites once everyone confirms. Any constraints on finalizing the mutual action plan before the kickoff? We usually lock MAPlines for tasks due in the first 30 days.

—Ben

Subject: Confirmed: POC kickoff (Sep 23 10:30–12:00) and security review (Sep 28 09:30)

Thanks everyone —

Confirmed schedule:
- Primary POC kickoff (technical + procurement): Wed Sep 23, 10:30–12:00 PST (calendar invite sent).
- Security review (30m): Mon Sep 28, 09:30–10:00 PST (placeholder invite sent).

Quick success criteria summary (to be finalized during kickoff):
- Integration: Redwood inference API called from Stellarmed staging app with <5% error rate for 5000 test requests.
- Latency: 95th percentile <250ms for typical 512-token requests under baseline synthetic load.
- Throughput: Sustained 100 concurrent requests with no more than 2x baseline latency degradation during peak windows.
- Data controls: KMS integration tested; logs show no customer PII in debug logs during test run.

Owners and immediate action items before kickoff:
- Ben Carter: finalize mutual action plan and send final MAP (done by Sep 21).
- Dylan Brooks: prepare I/O schema note + small demo repo; share by Sep 21.
- Laura Bennett: draft onboarding checklist and success-metrics doc; share by Sep 21.
- Dev Patel: confirm SOC2 checklist acceptance and note any additional evidence required; review with Maya on Sep 28.

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx, Stellarmed_mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf, POC-Runbook.md

If anything changes on your side, please reply here and I'll update the invites and MAP. Looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
